item.title: Domestic helper in M'sia attacks employer with knife, employer's son loses finger
item.description: A domestic helper attacked her employer and her son in Malaysia with a knife, severing the son's finger in the process.

item.title: Football Association of Malaysia investigated for doctoring birth certificates of foreign players
item.description: The Football Association of Malaysia admits to altering the birth certificates of their foreign players, but says it's an isolated incident.

item.title: Customer finds mould on discounted Oreo cheesecake from Esplanade MRT 7-Eleven, replacement mouldy too
item.description: A customer was "stunned" after finding that a discounted 7-Eleven cheesecake -- as well as its replacement -- had mould in it.

item.title: Mother in Thailand arrested while carrying baby for stealing cable wires to sell for drugs
item.description: A 45-year-old woman in Thailand was arrested while carrying her infant after police discovered she had stolen electrical wires to buy drugs.

item.title: Tesla driver swerves across 4 lanes in Chinatown, cuts off right-turning vehicle
item.description: A Tesla Model Y swerved around a right-tuning car before cutting across 4 lanes and back again through a Chinatown road.

item.title: Woman in S'pore gets jail after lying about home address to enrol daughter in primary school
item.description: A woman was sent to jail for one week for lying about her home address to enrol her daughter in a popular primary school.

item.title: Group of students in M'sia take graduation photos at pedestrian crossing, draws mixed reactions
item.description: Five female students were seen taking graduation photos at a pedestrian crossing in Kuala Lumpur City Centre.

item.title: Man eating at mamak stall in M'sia shot by gunmen, dies at the scene
item.description: A man was shot by three gunmen while he was eating at a mamak stall in Seremban before midnight on 19 Nov.

item.title: Wicked: For Good review - Ariana Grande shines in sequel
item.description: A rare sequel that outshines part one, Wicked: For Good dials up the pacing and impact, while still tying into The Wizard of Oz lore.

item.title: Why some kids become school bullies, & how to deal with them in S'pore?
item.description: As bullying in Singapore schools gets more visibility, we talk to experts to understand why bullies exist and how they can be dealt with.
